sample_order: interleave implementations for each sample; rotate order by size, mode and sample index
throughput_denominator: original binary bytes; invalid-input rows report latency only
output_capacity: identical preallocated buffers for every implementation: exact encode length; ceil(encoded_length / 4) * 3 for decode
output_alignment_guards: allocate 63 guard bytes outside the timed call, select a 64-byte-aligned exact-capacity slice, and verify guards; guard bytes are never passed as extra output capacity
rank_policy: all primary sizes and modes, encode/decode separate; compare against the fastest semantically matching competitor for each case; publish every sample and every competitor, including losses
